name: Error-Based Model Generation (Bottom-Up Fusion)
definition: A bottom-up simplification process starting from the highest resolution level (leaf nodes) to approximate the original dataset with fewer tetrahedra. It merges two child tetrahedra into their parent if fusion criteria are met.
summary: Error-Based Model Generation is a bottom-up simplification process that merges tetrahedra based on local approximation error to ensure geometric fidelity and prevent cracks between levels of detail.
